```{r, echo=TRUE}
## ==========================================================
## TFCE for an unbalanced between-subject 2 x 2 factorial
## design in R
##
## Full model:
##   Amplitude ~ FactorA + FactorB + Interaction
##
## Tests:
##   1. Factor A main effect
##   2. Factor B main effect
##   3. Factor A x Factor B interaction
##
## Permutation:
##   Freedman-Lane residual permutation
##
## Reduced models:
##
##   Factor A:
##     Amplitude ~ FactorB + Interaction
##
##   Factor B:
##     Amplitude ~ FactorA + Interaction
##
##   Interaction:
##     Amplitude ~ FactorA + FactorB
##
## A single subject-level residual permutation is reused across
## all Channel x Time points within each permutation.
## ==========================================================

rm(list = ls())

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(future)
library(future.apply)
library(progressr)
library(fields)

source("../R/tfce_transform.R")

cat("\nStarting TFCE 2 x 2 between-subject analysis...\n")

## ==========================================================
## -1. Load data
## ==========================================================

designTable <- read_csv("../data/04_designTable.csv")

EEGlong <- read_csv("../data/04_EEGdata_long.csv")

print(names(designTable))
print(names(EEGlong))

## ==========================================================
## 0. Prepare data
## ==========================================================

dat <- EEGlong %>%
  left_join(designTable, by = "Subject") %>%
  mutate(
    Subject = factor(Subject),
    Channel = factor(Channel),
    Time = as.numeric(Time),
    Amplitude = as.numeric(Amplitude),
    FactorA = as.numeric(FactorA),
    FactorB = as.numeric(FactorB),
    Interaction = as.numeric(Interaction)
  )

channels <- unique(EEGlong$Channel)
times <- sort(unique(EEGlong$Time))

nChan <- length(channels)
nTime <- length(times)


## ----------------------------------------------------------
## Check whether all 2 x 2 cells are present
## ----------------------------------------------------------

cell_sizes <- dat %>%
  count(FactorA, FactorB, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(FactorA, FactorB)

print(cell_sizes)

if (nrow(cell_sizes) != 4) {
  stop("All four FactorA x FactorB cells must be present.")
}

## ==========================================================
## -2. Function: compute t-map for one effect
## ==========================================================

compute_tmaps_2x2 <- function(data) {
  res <- data %>%
    group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      fit <- lm(Amplitude ~ FactorA * FactorB, data = .x)
      
      cf <- coef(summary(fit))
      
      tibble(t_A = cf["FactorA", "t value"],
             t_B = cf["FactorB", "t value"],
             t_Int = cf["FactorA:FactorB", "t value"])
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  make_matrix <- function(x) {
    tmat <- res %>%
      mutate(
        Channel = factor(Channel, levels = channels),
        Time = factor(Time, levels = times)
      ) %>%
      arrange(Channel, Time) %>%
      pull(x)
    
    matrix(
      tmat,
      nrow = nChan,
      ncol = nTime,
      byrow = TRUE,
      dimnames = list(channels, times)
    )
  }
  
  list(A = make_matrix("t_A"),
       B = make_matrix("t_B"),
       Int = make_matrix("t_Int"))
}

## ==========================================================
## Function: precompute reduced-model components
## ==========================================================

prepare_freedman_lane <- function(data, reduced_formula) {

  data %>%
    group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      fit_reduced <- lm(formula = reduced_formula, data = .x)
      
      .x %>%
        mutate(
          Y_hat_red = fitted(fit_reduced),
          resid_red = residuals(fit_reduced)
        )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
}

## ==========================================================
## Function: create a Freedman-Lane permuted dataset
## ==========================================================

construct_permuted_dataset <- function(fl_parts) {
  fl_parts %>%
    group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      df <- .x
      perm_idx <- sample(seq_len(length(unique(dat$Subject))))
      
      df$Amplitude <- df$Y_hat_red + df$resid_red[perm_idx]
      
      df
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
}

## ==========================================================
## Step 1: Observed t-maps
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 1: Computing observed t-maps...\n")

t_Obs <- compute_tmaps_2x2(dat)

t_ObsA <- t_Obs$A
t_ObsB <- t_Obs$B
t_ObsInt <- t_Obs$Int

cat("Observed t-maps completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 2: Observed TFCE maps
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 2: Computing observed TFCE maps...\n")

TFCE_ObsA <- tfce_transform(t_ObsA, E = 0.66, H = 2, dh = 0.1)

TFCE_ObsB <- tfce_transform(t_ObsB, E = 0.66, H = 2, dh = 0.1)

TFCE_ObsInt <- tfce_transform(t_ObsInt, E = 0.66, H = 2, dh = 0.1)

cat("Observed TFCE maps completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 3: Precompute Freedman-Lane components
## ==========================================================

cat(paste(
  "Step 3: Precomputing reduced-model fitted values",
  "and residuals...\n"
))

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## Factor A reduced model
##
## Remove FactorA while retaining FactorB and Interaction.
## ----------------------------------------------------------

FL_partsA <- prepare_freedman_lane(dat, Amplitude ~ FactorB + Interaction)

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## Factor B reduced model
##
## Remove FactorB while retaining FactorA and Interaction.
## ----------------------------------------------------------

FL_partsB <- prepare_freedman_lane(dat, Amplitude ~ FactorA + Interaction)

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## Interaction reduced model
##
## Remove Interaction while retaining FactorA and FactorB.
## ----------------------------------------------------------

FL_partsInt <- prepare_freedman_lane(dat, Amplitude ~ FactorA + FactorB)

cat("Reduced-model components completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 4: Freedman-Lane permutation testing
## ==========================================================

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 4.1 Set up parallel workers
## ----------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(123)

n_perm <- 999

n_workers <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)

plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)

handlers("txtprogressbar")

cat(
  "Step 4: Starting parallel Freedman-Lane permutation testing ",
  "with ",
  n_workers,
  " workers...\n",
  sep = ""
)


with_progress({
  progress_update <- progressor(along = seq_len(n_perm))
  
  permutation_results <- future_lapply(seq_len(n_perm), function(p) {
    ## ----------------------------------------------------
    ## Factor A permutation
    ## ----------------------------------------------------
    
    perm_datA <- construct_permuted_dataset(FL_partsA)
    
    t_permA <- compute_tmaps_2x2(perm_datA)$A
    
    TFCE_permA <- tfce_transform(t_permA,
                                 E = 0.66,
                                 H = 2,
                                 dh = 0.1)
    
    perm_maxA <- max(abs(TFCE_permA), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    ## ----------------------------------------------------
    ## Factor B permutation
    ## ----------------------------------------------------
    
    perm_datB <- construct_permuted_dataset(FL_partsB)
    
    t_permB <- compute_tmaps_2x2(perm_datB)$B
    
    TFCE_permB <- tfce_transform(t_permB,
                                 E = 0.66,
                                 H = 2,
                                 dh = 0.1)
    
    perm_maxB <- max(abs(TFCE_permB), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    
    ## ----------------------------------------------------
    ## Interaction permutation
    ## ----------------------------------------------------
    
    perm_datInt <- construct_permuted_dataset(FL_partsInt)
    
    t_permInt <- compute_tmaps_2x2(perm_datInt)$Int
    
    TFCE_permInt <- tfce_transform(t_permInt,
                                   E = 0.66,
                                   H = 2,
                                   dh = 0.1)
    
    perm_maxInt <- max(abs(TFCE_permInt), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    ## Update progress bar once per completed permutation
    progress_update()
    
    ## Return the three permutation maxima
    c(A = perm_maxA, B = perm_maxB, Int = perm_maxInt)
  }, ## Reproducible parallel random-number generation
  future.seed = TRUE, ## Packages required by the workers
  future.packages = c("dplyr", "tidyr"))
})


## ----------------------------------------------------------
## Combine worker results
## ----------------------------------------------------------

permutation_results <- do.call(rbind, permutation_results)

TFCE_permMaxA <- permutation_results[, "A"]
TFCE_permMaxB <- permutation_results[, "B"]
TFCE_permMaxInt <- permutation_results[, "Int"]

## Return to ordinary sequential processing
plan(sequential)

cat("Permutation testing completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 5: TFCE-corrected significance
## ==========================================================


cat("Step 5: Computing TFCE-corrected significance...\n")

alpha <- 0.05

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## Critical values
## ----------------------------------------------------------

maxTFCE_A <- sort(c(TFCE_permMaxA, max(abs(TFCE_ObsA), na.rm = TRUE)))
maxTFCE_B <- sort(c(TFCE_permMaxB, max(abs(TFCE_ObsB), na.rm = TRUE)))
maxTFCE_Int <- sort(c(TFCE_permMaxInt, max(abs(TFCE_ObsInt), na.rm = TRUE)))

maxTFCEcrit_A <- maxTFCE_A[round((n_perm + 1) * (1 - alpha))]
maxTFCEcrit_B  <- maxTFCE_B[round((n_perm + 1) * (1 - alpha))]
maxTFCEcrit_Int <- maxTFCE_Int[round((n_perm + 1) * (1 - alpha))]


## ----------------------------------------------------------
## Corrected significance masks
## ----------------------------------------------------------

MaskA <- abs(TFCE_ObsA) >= maxTFCEcrit_A

MaskB <- abs(TFCE_ObsB) >= maxTFCEcrit_B

MaskInt <- abs(TFCE_ObsInt) >= maxTFCEcrit_Int

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## Corrected p-value function
## ----------------------------------------------------------

compute_pvalues <- function(observed_tfce, TFCE_permMax) {
  p_values <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = nrow(observed_tfce),
    ncol = ncol(observed_tfce),
    dimnames = dimnames(observed_tfce)
  )
  
  for (ch in seq_len(nrow(observed_tfce))) {
    for (tp in seq_len(ncol(observed_tfce))) {
      p_values[ch, tp] <-
        (sum(TFCE_permMax >=
               abs(observed_tfce[ch, tp]), na.rm = TRUE) + 1) /
        (length(TFCE_permMax) + 1)
    }
  }
  
  p_values
}

P_ValuesA <- compute_pvalues(TFCE_ObsA, TFCE_permMaxA)

P_ValuesB <- compute_pvalues(TFCE_ObsB, TFCE_permMaxB)

P_ValuesInt <- compute_pvalues(TFCE_ObsInt, TFCE_permMaxInt)

cat("TFCE-corrected significance completed.\n")

cat(sprintf("Critical TFCE value for Factor A = %.4f\n", maxTFCEcrit_A))

cat(sprintf("Critical TFCE value for Factor B = %.4f\n", maxTFCEcrit_B))

cat(sprintf(
  paste0("Critical TFCE value for ", "Factor A x Factor B = %.4f\n"),
  maxTFCEcrit_Int
))

## ==========================================================
## Step 6: Store results
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 6: Storing results...\n")

Results <- list(

  ## Factor A
  tObs_A = t_ObsA,
  TFCE_Obs_A = TFCE_ObsA,
  TFCE_Null_A = TFCE_permMaxA,
  maxTFCEcritA = maxTFCEcrit_A,
  P_ValuesA = P_ValuesA,
  Mask_A = MaskA,

  ## Factor B
  tObs_B = t_ObsB,
  TFCE_Obs_B = TFCE_ObsB,
  TFCE_Null_B = TFCE_permMaxB,
  maxTFCEcritB = maxTFCEcrit_B,
  P_ValuesB = P_ValuesB,
  Mask_B = MaskB,

  ## Interaction
  tObs_Int = t_ObsInt,
  TFCE_Obs_Int = TFCE_ObsInt,
  TFCE_Null_Int = TFCE_permMaxInt,
  maxTFCEcritInt = maxTFCEcrit_Int,
  P_ValuesInt = P_ValuesInt,
  Mask_Int = MaskInt,

  ## Analysis information
  alpha = alpha,
  n_perm = n_perm,

  model =
    "Amplitude ~ FactorA + FactorB + Interaction",

  test_A =
    paste("Factor A main effect adjusted for", "Factor B and Interaction"), 

  test_B =
    paste("Factor B main effect adjusted for", "Factor A and Interaction"), 

  test_Int =
    paste("Factor A x Factor B interaction",
          "adjusted for Factor A and Factor B"), 
  
  permutation_A =
    paste("Freedman-Lane under reduced model:",
          "Amplitude ~ FactorB + Interaction"), 

  permutation_B =
    paste("Freedman-Lane under reduced model:",
          "Amplitude ~ FactorA + Interaction"), 

  permutation_Int =
    paste("Freedman-Lane under reduced model:",
          "Amplitude ~ FactorA + FactorB"), 

  balanced =
    length(unique(cell_sizes$n)) == 1, cell_sizes =
    cell_sizes
)

cat("Results stored.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 7: Save results
## ==========================================================

if (!dir.exists("../Results")) {
  dir.create("../Results", recursive = TRUE)
}

save(Results, times, nChan, channels, file =
       "../Results/04_TFCE_between_subject_unbalanced.RData")

cat("\nTFCE 2 x 2 between-subject analysis completed.\n")

cat(
  paste0(
    "Saved results: ",
    "../Results/",
    "04_TFCE_between_subject_unbalanced.RData\n"
  )
)
```


```{r, echo=TRUE}
## ==========================================================
## Plot significant corrected t-maps
## ==========================================================
rm(list =ls())
source("../R/plot_eeg_map.R")

load("../Results/04_TFCE_between_subject_unbalanced.RData")

## ========================================================== 
## Plot TFCE-corrected significant t-maps 
## ========================================================== 
mA <- Results$tObs_A 
mA[!Results$Mask_A] <- 0 
plot_eeg_map( mA, "TFCE-corrected Factor A Main Effect", times, nChan, channels )

mB <- Results$tObs_B 
mB[!Results$Mask_B] <- 0 
plot_eeg_map( mB, "TFCE-corrected Factor B Main Effect", times, nChan, channels )

mInt <- Results$tObs_Int 
mInt[!Results$Mask_Int] <- 0 
plot_eeg_map( mInt, "TFCE-corrected Factor A x Factor B Interaction", times, nChan, channels ) 
## ========================================================== 
## Plot observed TFCE maps 
## ========================================================== 
plot_eeg_map( Results$TFCE_Obs_A, "Observed TFCE Map: Factor A", times, nChan, channels ) 
plot_eeg_map( Results$TFCE_Obs_B, "Observed TFCE Map: Factor B", times, nChan, channels ) 
plot_eeg_map( Results$TFCE_Obs_Int, "Observed TFCE Map: Factor A x Factor B Interaction", times, nChan, channels )
```
